name: West Route

mixed.sentence: The mountain's original (and for decades only) route climbs class 3-4 terrain along the ridge crest with a short, exposed low-5th-class step to top out the summit block; two later technical lines — a 5.7 South Face and a 5.6 West Face first climbed in 2001 — are more sustained rock routes
mixed.why: The beta describes the East Ridge (the 1915 original ridge-crest line with the low-5th summit step) and lists the South Face. The page's own overview says the West Route is the west-side gully, and its fa (Hehn/Stephens 2001) belongs to the 5.6 West Face the beta lists as a different line.
mixed.fix: The West Route climbs the older west-side gully to the shared summit block; it is now less favored because of rockfall. Nearly all parties bring a rope and light rack to protect and rappel the final block.

identity_problem: The overview says West Route = Beckey's west gully, the fa is the 2001 West Face, and the beta describes the East Ridge.
